as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

navigate.description: Function to navigate to the selected item

scrollToIndexFn.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

ids.type: Partial<{ root: string; label: string; control: string; input: string; content: string; list: string; trigger: string; clearTrigger: string; item: (id: string, index?: number) => string; positioner: string; itemGroup: (id: string | number) => string; itemGroupLabel: (id: string | number) => string; }>
ids.description: The ids of the elements in the combobox. Useful for composition.

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

collection.description:
The items, e.g. from `createListCollection`, or `createPageListCollection` for nested pages,
where an item with a `parent` value is shown on the page of that item

filter.description: Returns the items that match the query. Defaults to a fuzzy search of the item text and its `keywords`.

inputValue.description: The controlled value of the combobox's input

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.
